column_description: Full name of the user. may be NULL.
Email address of the user. may be NULL.
Role of the user (e.g., researcher, admin, analyst). always exactly one of 'researcher', 'admin', 'analyst'. may be NULL.
Password for the user account. may be NULL.
Timestamp when the user was created. may be NULL.
Timestamp when the user was last updated. may be NULL.
